blocks.text: Keep 20% for the life of every customer you send
Capacitor teams use Capgo to ship live updates instead of waiting on App Store review. You earn 20% of every payment they make, for as long as they stay.
Paid on every invoice, not the first month
Most programs pay once. We do not.
A one-time 20% looks similar on day one. Lifetime is what makes the work worth it.
$7.80 once for a Maker customer. Then nothing.
$79.20 in year one — and it does not stop
Capgo customers pay every month. So do we — to you.
Examples use current list prices and 20% of each invoice. Yearly columns use annual billing, which is discounted versus 12 monthly invoices.
$78/mo recurring, $792/year — still paying even if you stop posting.
One agency putting five client apps on Maker is $39/mo from a single relationship.
The problem your audience already has
When a production bug hits a Capacitor app, waiting 24–48 hours for App Store or Play review is too slow. Teams need a fix out today, with a rollback if it misses.
Capgo lets them push encrypted web-layer updates over the air, run native cloud builds, and roll out through staging, beta, and production channels — then roll back in one click.
Easy to recommend, because it solves a real pain
Ship a JS fix in minutes instead of waiting 24–48 hours on the stores
One-click rollback if a release goes wrong
OTA updates, channels, native cloud builds, and plugins in one toolchain
Engineers on Capacitor or Ionic with Vue, React, Svelte, or Angular who hate waiting on store review.
Shops shipping and maintaining apps for many clients. One agency relationship can mean several Capgo accounts.
Product managers and CTOs who need faster iteration, channels, and a rollback they can trust.

How long is the cookie window?
30 days. If someone clicks your link and starts a paid plan inside that window, the referral is yours.
Who should I promote Capgo to?
Capacitor and Ionic developers, agencies with client apps, and product teams who need to ship mobile fixes without store delay.

Free to join. Get your link, share Capgo with Capacitor teams, and keep 20% for as long as they stay.
